blocks.name: Video deliveries
blocks.description: Upload each cut or version. The client watches it here, comments, and approves or asks for changes.

blocks.name: Photo proofing
blocks.description: Share the photos from a shoot. The client marks Pick, Maybe or No on each one, and you see the selection live.

blocks.name: Design proofs
blocks.description: Logos, posters, packaging or app screens for approval, round by round, with comments on each.

blocks.name: Final deliveries
blocks.description: Everything the client receives, with due dates, final files and download links.

blocks.name: Big file transfer
blocks.description: Send and receive large files both ways: raw footage, project files, exports. Big videos are compressed for smooth streaming.

blocks.name: Shoot schedule
blocks.description: Shoot days with call time, location, crew and the call sheet, on a calendar you both see.

blocks.name: Shot list
blocks.description: Every shot or scene to capture, ticked off on the day so the client knows nothing was missed.

blocks.name: Creative brief
blocks.description: The brief, audience, tone, references and must-haves, written together and always up to date.

blocks.name: Mood board
blocks.description: Reference photos and videos for the look and feel, added by you or the client.

blocks.name: Talent and locations
blocks.description: Models, influencers, voice artists and venues with photos and rates. The client shortlists with you.

blocks.name: Products to shoot
blocks.description: The client's products with SKU, whether the sample arrived, shoot status and the final photos.

blocks.name: Brand kit
blocks.description: Logos, fonts, colours and guidelines, so both sides always use the same version.

blocks.name: Content calendar
blocks.description: Posts and videos per platform with caption and asset. The client approves before anything is published.

blocks.name: Scripts and captions
blocks.description: Video scripts, captions and ad copy as proper documents: filter by status, write, the client reads, comments and approves.

blocks.name: Campaigns
blocks.description: Each brand campaign with goal, dates, budget and status, across all the client's brands.

blocks.name: Ad spend
blocks.description: What was spent on ads per platform and what it brought in, with the receipt. Totals update live.

blocks.name: Monthly reports
blocks.description: Each month's numbers (reach, engagement, followers) with the full report to download.

blocks.name: App releases
blocks.description: Builds for the client to test, with version, platform, download or store link, release notes and sign-off.

blocks.name: Bug reports
blocks.description: The client reports a problem with a screenshot or screen recording. You fix it and they see the status change.

blocks.name: Feature requests
blocks.description: New ideas from the client, prioritised together, with your estimate and progress.

blocks.name: Project milestones
blocks.description: Phases with deadlines and progress, so the client always knows where the project stands.

blocks.name: Links and access
blocks.description: Staging sites, test builds, drive folders, store listings and dashboards in one place. Never store passwords here.

blocks.name: Domains and hosting
blocks.description: The client's domains, hosting and SSL with renewal dates and yearly cost, so nothing expires by surprise.

blocks.name: Support requests
blocks.description: The client raises a request with a screenshot; you reply, fix and close it. Both sides see every step.

blocks.name: Maintenance log
blocks.description: Updates, fixes, backups and security work done on the client's site or app each month, with hours.

blocks.name: Invoices
blocks.description: Invoices with line items, discount and VAT that the client can open, print or save as PDF. Track paid and overdue.

blocks.name: Quotes and estimates
blocks.description: Price the job from line items. The client reads the quote and accepts it; print it as a PDF.

blocks.name: Receipts and expenses
blocks.description: Receipts for money spent on the client's project, with a photo, amount and who paid. Either side can add them.

blocks.name: Payments
blocks.description: Advance, milestone and final payments with due dates and proof. The client uploads proof, you mark it received.

blocks.name: Project ledger
blocks.description: Money in and money out for the project with a running balance, by month and category.

blocks.name: Retainer hours
blocks.description: Hours worked against the client's monthly retainer, so both sides see what is used and what is left.

blocks.name: Project budget
blocks.description: Planned against spent for every budget line of the project, with what is left.

blocks.name: Project updates
blocks.description: Post progress with photos or short clips. The client sees every update in one timeline.

blocks.name: Messages
blocks.description: Chat with the client in one place: text, photos, videos and files. Everyone on the project sees it live.

blocks.name: Tasks and requests
blocks.description: What you need from the client and what they need from you, with owner, due date and status.

blocks.name: To-do list
blocks.description: Type a to-do and press Enter. Assign it to either side, give it a date, tick it off. No forms.

blocks.name: Meeting notes
blocks.description: Agenda, notes, decisions and next steps from every call with the client.

blocks.name: Shared notes
blocks.description: Free pages for anything: ideas, checklists, contacts, plans. Written together, always the latest version.

blocks.name: Decisions and polls
blocks.description: Let the client choose: which thumbnail, which name, which colour. Votes show live.

blocks.name: Contracts and sign-off
blocks.description: Send the agreement, NDA or scope of work. The client downloads it, signs, and uploads the signed copy.

blocks.name: Shared documents
blocks.description: Proposals, briefs, NDAs, reports and guides in one place, each with its latest file.

blocks.name: Guides and FAQs
blocks.description: How-tos for the client: updating the website, posting guidelines, who to call for what.

blocks.name: Feedback and reviews
blocks.description: The client rates the work and leaves a review, and says whether you may use it as a testimonial.

blocks.name: Overview page
blocks.description: A front page with totals, what waits for review, what is due soon and the latest changes.
